data.title: Crotamiton (10%)
data.summary: Scabicides & pediculicides · Scabicide with antipruritic action
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Scabicides & pediculicides_

**Class:** Scabicide with antipruritic action

## Mechanism of action
- Mechanism unclear; weakly scabicidal; antipruritic (blocks TRPV4 itch channel)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Scabies (second-line, less effective), post-scabetic itch, pruritus of other causes

## Dose & formulations
- Scabies: apply neck down for 2–5 consecutive nights, wash off 48 h after last application

## Adverse effects
- Irritation, contact dermatitis; low efficacy (frequent failure)

## Contraindications
- Raw/weeping skin, mucosa

## Pregnancy & lactation
Limited data; permethrin preferred.

## Viva points
- Weak scabicide but good antipruritic — post-scabetic itch

_Sources: Khopkar ch.21 (Crotamiton); Wolverton 4e ch.44. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
